categories.main_business_segments: Focus Systems Corporation operates four main business segments: Public Sector Solutions (systems for government agencies and municipalities), Enterprise Solutions (core business systems and IT consulting for corporations), Wide-area Solutions (system development for communications, embedded systems, and AI solutions), and Innovation (infrastructure, mainframe, IoT, and information security products and solutions).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in custom software development, system integration, cloud and web applications, network infrastructure, RPA, embedded software, and information security technologies such as encryption, digital watermarking, and beacon technology. Project management and individual cost-based accounting are key to their production methods, with a focus on both in-house and collaborative development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large SIers (such as NTT Data and IBM), government agencies, local municipalities, and private corporations across various industries. Major end markets are public sector infrastructure, enterprise IT, communications, manufacturing, and information security.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates in Japan, with major activities centered in Tokyo, Nagoya, and Osaka. Over 90% of revenue is derived from domestic customers, and all fixed assets are located in Japan.
categories.supply_chain_position: Focus Systems acts as a midstream IT service provider, delivering system integration, software development, and IT solutions directly to large SIers, end-user corporations, and public sector clients. It also provides downstream value through proprietary security products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing value-added services, expanding new business domains, and strengthening human capital. R&D focuses on new technologies, IoT, information security, and collaborative research with external experts, with an emphasis on developing proprietary products and solutions for emerging needs such as digital transformation and social issues.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through project-based software development, system integration contracts, IT consulting, maintenance and operation services, and sales of proprietary security and IoT products. Revenue recognition is based on progress for long-term projects and at delivery for product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include other Japanese system integrators and IT service firms such as NTT Data, IBM Japan, and other large SIers. Focus Systems positions itself as a reliable, long-term partner with deep expertise in public sector and enterprise systems, and differentiates through its breadth of technical capabilities and proprietary security solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, the company reported record-high sales of 32.6 billion yen (up 3.3% YoY), operating profit of 2.17 billion yen (up 10.0%), and net profit of 1.57 billion yen (up 11.4%). The company has shown steady growth over the past five years, with a workforce of 1,398 employees and a strong balance sheet.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Focus Systems emphasizes its ability to deliver comprehensive, high-quality IT solutions tailored to complex public and enterprise needs, leveraging deep domain expertise, long-term client relationships, and proprietary security technologies. Its differentiation lies in its broad technical coverage, reliability as a partner for mission-critical systems, and its capacity to innovate in response to evolving digital and security challenges.
